penalties.authority: Assistant Commissioner Central Goods & Services Tax Division-I, Derabassi.
penalties.details: The GST demand being raised amounts to Rs 31.50 lacs along with applicable Interest as per section 50(1) of the CGST Act, 2017. Additionally, a penalty of Rs. 31.50 lacs have been imposed in terms of Section 74(1) of the CGST Act, 2017 and Section 20 of the IGST Act, 2017 subject to the Statutory Option of availing relief under Section 74(11) of the CGST Act, 2017.
penalties.impact: As per legal opinion obtained by the Company the aforesaid demand has no merits in terms of the Circular No. 204/16/2023-GST dated October 27, 2023. This circular provides clarification on the taxability and valuation of personal guarantees by directors and corporate guarantees between related persons (e.g., holding and subsidiary companies). Company will make its submissions before the Adjudicating Authority within the given timelines. The demand will not have any impact on the company’s profitability/financial position or operations.

industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Industrial Products > Iron & Steel Products

operating_notes.text: JTL received ACRS certification for structural hollow sections for its Mangaon, Raigad plant and commenced DFT pipe supplies to the US.
FY26 sales volumes reached 395,900 MT with export contribution at ~10.4%.
JTL Defence achieved 100 metric tons production in Q4, running at 150 metric tons monthly, targeting 500 metric tons per month by exit quarter.
Q1FY27 sales volume reached 1,18,513 MT with 17.8% YoY growth
Export order book at ₹75 Cr; domestic order book is a moving market with 1 lakh tons typically in the system
Working capital cycle improved to 75 days in Q1FY27 from 90 days, targeting 35-40 days by FY28

timeline.summary: JTL Defence (erstwhile RCI Industries) received BSE trading approval for 1.05 Cr equity shares to commence trading on 27 April 2026
JTL Industries received Product Conformity Certification from ACRS for structural hollow sections at its Mangaon facility, becoming the sole Indian company to hold this certification.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹692.68 Cr (+47.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹34.41 Cr.
JTL Industries reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,136 Cr and net profit of ₹103 Cr, driven by record sales volumes of 395,900 MT.
2026-05-11: JTL uploaded audio recording of its Q4FY26 and FY26 earnings conference call
JTL Industries hosted its Q4FY26 earnings conference call on May 11, 2026, detailing FY27 guidance and capex plans.
Pranav Singla, on behalf of JTL Industries Limited’s promoter group, declared no new encumbrances on shares as of April 7, 2026, per SEBI Regulation 31(4).
JTL Industries posts record Q1FY27 revenue of ₹722 Cr, EBITDA ₹59 Cr; 30% volume growth guidance intact
